title: Warehouse Incharge/ Warehouse Assistant
description:
Role & Responsibilities: Warehouse & Logistics: Manage daily warehouse operations, including inventory management, stock control, and logistics coordination. 
 Procurement: Oversee procurement processes for IT equipment and supplies to ensure timely delivery and adherence to quality standards. 
 Vendor Management: Coordinate with vendors to seamlessly resolve issues regarding purchase orders, invoices, and deliveries. 
 Record Keeping: Maintain precise records of inventory levels, stock movements, and all vendor interactions. 
 Compliance: Ensure strict alignment with company policies regarding supply chain management, sourcing strategies, and project procurement.

Key Skills: Capex,IT Procurement,SCM,Inventory,Procurement Management,Purchase,Project Procurement,Supplier
